title: TheMachineShop
content: Instead of TheMallWorld, I often dream of TheMachineShop. It is enormous. For most of the time when I am there I get lost trying to find particular part of it like, for instance, the welding shop or some other place. The shop is really big and also has many levels and lifts that can take you to different floors. Sometimes parts of it seem to be menacing and I know that I am not supposed to go there. However, its never a nightmare being there. Most of the time it is just annoying, because it is so difficult to stay on track and find the place I am looking for. Last night I was looking for the Storeroom. I needed a coat, it was getting cold. The storeman (Bruno) kept calling me, telling me that he is waiting for me and that he hasn't got all day. I got lost because the lift took me to the wrong floor. It was a top floor and the construction workers were busy there building another level. It was raining, but I did not get wet, staying mostly under cover. I woke up.
